summary: Offline pytest + code review of the refined ownership_evidence()/recipients_reconcile in routes_pix.py. The 5 listed files ran with 74 passed (plus 9 subtests) in 0.85s. No live HTTP, Stripe or production calls were made. All requested invariants hold in the code.

minor.issue: If the record name has only one token longer than 2 chars (e.g. 'Maria'), rec_tokens[0] == rec_tokens[-1], so any Stripe name with 2+ tokens that contains that one token counts as a name proof. This is a weaker proof than intended. Consider requiring len(rec_tokens) >= 2.
Name tokens are not normalized for accents or punctuation ('José' vs 'Jose', 'Torres,'). This can only cause false negatives, so it is safe but may block real owners from reconciling.

action_items: Optional: add tests where KYC is not complete (non-empty requirements.currently_due, past_due or disabled_reason with charges and payouts enabled) to show kyc_stripe_concluido is False and reconcile is refused

Optional: add a test where the Stripe name has a single token (e.g. 'Sheyson') and is the only other proof, to show it is rejected by points rather than by the uniqueness check (acct_d is currently only used in the shared-account test)
Optional: require at least 2 significant tokens in the record name before counting a name proof
critical_code_review_comments: Verified: name proof requires the first and last significant (>2 chars) tokens of the record name to be present in a Stripe name (business_profile.name or individual first+last), and the Stripe name must have at least 2 tokens
Verified: kyc_stripe_concluido = charges_enabled AND payouts_enabled AND no currently_due, past_due or disabled_reason
Verified: suficiente = conta_unica_na_base (no other partner or influencer has the same pix_stripe_account_id) AND at least 2 of the 3 proofs

Verified reconcile order: already bound to the same owner -> 'já associado'; any partner_id or influencer_id in metadata -> conflict, never rewritten; then country == BR and id == stored account; then evidence; only after that a single accounts.update with metadata only and an idempotency key, followed by an audit entry
The case where the partner and influencer share one account is caught by the uniqueness check (conta_unica=False)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the 5 listed pytest files offline (they should give 74 passed). The reconcile tests use mongomock_motor and a mocked provider. Test coverage gaps are listed in action_items.
